csv_scope_of_work: Amtrak Bridge Replacements - AML 79.85 - Blackman Rd and AML 79.99 - Blackman Drain. This project will complete the design of the replacement of two structures on the Amtrak Michigan Line. AML-79.85 Blackman Rd Replace the existing structure increasing the total length of the bridge to accommodate a two-lane road replacing the existing one lane road. (Roadwork will not be included with this project.) Improve under clearance to meet 14 6 minimum. AML-79.99 Blackman Creek Replace existing culvert crossing with a new concrete box culvert, increase size to meet current hydraulic and Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy (EGLE) requirements. Project Location: The project is located on the Amtrak Michigan Line between approximately MP 79.2 and MP 80.5, in Blackman Township, Jackson County.
